seasonseries.title: Atlanta United FC vs. New York City FC

keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Matt Edwards, Atlanta United. Atlanta United 0, New York City FC 1.

Goal! Atlanta United 1, New York City FC 1. Giuliano Galoppo (Atlanta United) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tomás Jacob following a corner.
Luke Brennan (Atlanta United) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Daniel Chica replaces Tomás Jacob.
Goal! Atlanta United 1, New York City FC 2. Andrés Perea (New York City FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Agustín Ojeda with a cross.
Substitution, New York City FC. Luighi replaces Bénie Traoré.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Jay Fortune replaces Cooper Sanchez.
Goal! Atlanta United 2, New York City FC 2. Jay Fortune (Atlanta United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Tristan Muyumba.
Substitution, New York City FC. Kevin O'Toole replaces Nico Cavallo.
Substitution, Atlanta United. Steven Alzate replaces Giuliano Galoppo.
